description.value: The West Kelowna Branch is part of the Okanagan Regional Library, BC's 16th largest library system, located in the Westridge Centre on Old Okanagan Highway. The branch offers two free study rooms, a 40-seat meeting room, exam invigilation services, and regular community programming. Free parking is available in the Westridge Centre lot, making it a convenient and sheltered stop in the heart of West Kelowna.
